findings: the prior plan used reconciled as if it were a provider outcome and a reconciliation method at the same time
manual reconciliation had no Case, evidence or duty-separation authority
accepted asynchronous results and unknown results without a provider reference had no canonical closure path
compensation was a new Proposal but its ActionType, payload and eligibility were not policy bound
provider outcome, reconciliation method and settlement status are now separate typed dimensions
automatic reconcile uses a durable attempt and manual reconcile uses an evidence-backed maker-checker Case
unresolved evidence remains unknown and cannot trigger blind resend or compensation
CompensationPolicy maps only confirmed applied or partial effects to an exact inverse action and full safety chain
lineage preserves original effect, reconciliation evidence, compensation and residual effect
W5-05 remains unchecked until W5-04 and all named reconcile and compensation dependencies are GREEN
